brief_summary: A clinical study to determine the safety and efficacy of MK-0431 in patients with Type 2 diabetes mellitus who have inadequate glycemic control on diet/exercise therapy
brief_title: MK-0431 Early Phase II Double-blind Study - Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (0431-043)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients have type 2 diabetes mellitus
* On diet/exercise therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients have type 1 diabetes mellitus

interventions.name: MK0431, sitagliptin phosphate / Duration of Treatment: 12 Weeks
Comparator : placebo (unspecified) / Duration of Treatment: 12 Weeks

official_title: MK0431 Early Phase II Double-blind Study - Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
